item.title: Hubble Captures A Dying Star’s Final Breath In Spectacular New Image
item.description: NASA's trusty old Hubble Space Telescope has captured the death throes of the youngest and closest pre-planetary nebula from us, offering the most detailed view yet of the Egg Nebula's outflows of glowing gas, light, and dust.
